question: May quorum-backfill votes projected from persisted panel-result verdict maps carry recorded_before_other_votes_read=true?
ruling: YES. inv2's blindness clause guards independence of judgment. Each projected verdict was formed during the source lane's isolated review execution and persisted to _run/s9/panel-results/ before any sibling votes or findings were disclosed to that lane (reviewers see only their pack/worklist evidence by design). The projection event is post-hoc plumbing and is stamped separately (backfill:true, blind_at_source:true, projection_event, source). Setting the flag false would misdescribe the verdict's provenance and trip inv2 on 1,443 votes whose judgments were in fact blind.
precedent: vote-semantics-cutover.json (2026-07-09): orchestrator ruling recorded, fix applied at data layer with provenance stamps.
scope: Applies only to rows staged by scripts/s9/backfill_quorum.py with backfill:true. Live votes remain governed by the plain flag.
